evidence: Modifies RPC argument handling and deprecation behavior in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp for createrawtransaction and createpsbt.
rationale: Follows standard RPC deprecation discipline to phase out redundant 'replaceable' arguments across transaction-creation RPCs. Since full-RBF became default in v28, opt-in sequence signaling is largely obsolete, making argument deprecation a worthwhile interface cleanup.
